result.title: Distill to Loop: Turning Pretrained Diffusion Transformers into Looped Models with Adjustable Depth
result.summary: Looped transformers reuse one block of shared weights along the depth of the network. Recent looped diffusion transformers are trained from scratch, which repeats the full pretraining cost although strong pretrained non-looped diffusion transformers exist. We propose Distill to Loop (Dooop), which distills a pretrained non-looped diffusion transformer into a looped student whose blocks are initialized from the teacher's. We cast distillation as a fixed-point iteration toward the teacher, in which the output after every loop is trained toward the teacher, and each loop is one step of an ordinary differential equation in depth. As a result, one model runs any number of loops at test time without retraining, and the higher-order ODE solvers of diffusion model sampling can be applied along the depth dimension for better results. Meanwhile, because a looped model produces an output after every loop, we also construct loop guidance between the outputs of different loop counts, which improves the generated samples at little extra compute. On SD3-medium, a looped student with about 37% of the teacher's parameters matches the teacher on average over GenEval, ImageReward, PickScore and HPSv2.1 with two to four loops, and with two loops it uses about 58% of the teacher's compute. And on a four-step SD3-medium, loop guidance raises the average of the four metrics from 88.2 to 99.2.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Dooop，把预训练的非循环扩散 Transformer 蒸馏为权重共享的循环学生模型：将蒸馏视为朝教师输出的不动点迭代，每次循环输出都对齐教师，并把每次循环看作深度方向 ODE 的一步；由此同一个模型可在测试时任意设定循环次数而无需重训，还可在深度方向套用高阶 ODE 求解器，并提出在不同循环次数输出之间做 loop guidance。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作虽属图像生成，但其「每次迭代都对齐教师」的循环训练监督、测试时可变循环深度与跨循环输出引导，可能为 LVR 的循环 latent 状态训练、动态计算/停止决策及中间状态一致性筛选提供可核查线索。
